name: darwade-profile
description: Personal profile and IAP campaign landing page for Dr. Abhinay Bhaskar Darwade

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .prerender --emptyOutDir && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:standalone: npm run typecheck && vite build -c vite.standalone.config.ts && node scripts/inline-standalone.mjs
